args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion, from the Coastal team:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb, so the old name should no longer be used for this account.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That report needs its label updated to Pellow Home Living so the old name doesn't keep showing up.
- Please check for any other saved reports, templates or digests that still use "Covey & Lark" or "Covey".
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Bettina Kroll
Coastal team lead
